name: Inference-Time Clustering
aliases: Inference-Time Clustering — K-Means Token Merging, Token Clustering
definition: Clustering geometry tokens into K groups using k-means in cosine space to merge redundant tokens from multiple views, allowing adjustable compression at inference without retraining.
summary: Inference-Time Clustering dynamically compresses geometry tokens via iterative spherical k-means to reduce Gaussian budgets while preserving cross-view consistency.
